member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Aggregates.ITerminatable
member.summary: Opt-in interface for aggregate states that support tombstoning (FR66). When is true, EventStoreAggregate.ProcessAsync rejects all subsequent commands with an AggregateTerminated rejection event.
member.remarks: States implementing this interface MUST also provide a no-op Apply(AggregateTerminated) method, because the framework persists AggregateTerminated rejection events to the event stream and rehydration replays all events.

member.name: P:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Aggregates.ITerminatable.IsTerminated
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this aggregate has been permanently terminated.

Pattern: {tenant}:{domain}:{aggId}:events: — isolation is guaranteed because colons are forbidden in tenant/domain/aggregateId components, making each tenant's key space structurally disjoint from all other tenants (D1, FR15, FR28).

member.name: P:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Identity.AggregateIdentity.MetadataKey
member.summary: Gets the metadata key for state store lookups. Pattern: {tenant}:{domain}:{aggId}:metadata — tenant-scoped by the same 4-layer isolation model: (1) input validation rejects colons, (2) composite key prefixing, (3) DAPR actor scoping, (4) JWT tenant enforcement (FR15, FR28).

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.KebabConverter
member.summary: Converts PascalCase strings to kebab-case. Internal helper for MessageType assembly. Unlike NamingConventionEngine, this does NOT strip suffixes — raw type name conversion only.

member.name: M:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.KebabConverter.WordBoundaryRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
(?<=[a-z0-9])([A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])([A-Z][a-z])|(?<=[a-zA-Z])([0-9])
Explanation:
○ Match with 3 alternative expressions, atomically.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Zero-width positive lookbehind.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] right-to-left.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z].
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Zero-width positive lookbehind.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z] right-to-left.
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z].
○ Match a character in the set [a-z].
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Zero-width positive lookbehind.
○ Match an ASCII letter right-to-left.
○ 3rd capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9].

member.summary: Converts a PascalCase string to kebab-case.

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.MessageType
member.summary: Strongly-typed value object representing a message type in the format {domain}-{name}-v{ver}. Immutable, equatable, and serialized as a plain JSON string via .

member.name: F:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.MessageType.MaxLength
member.summary: Maximum total length of the canonical MessageType string. Domain max 64 + name max 120 + "-v" + version digits ≈ 192.

member.name: M:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.MessageType.DomainRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-z0-9]+$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.MessageType.NameRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z].
○ Optional (greedy).
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9a-z] greedily any number of times.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z].
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Messages.MessageType.VersionSuffixRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
-v(\\d+)$
Explanation:
○ Match the string "-v".
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Queries.IProjectionActor
member.summary: Implementation-neutral projection query method contract for generic query serving.
member.remarks: EventStore routes POST /api/v1/queries to runtime adapters exposing this method contract. DAPR actor hosts should mirror this method on their runtime-owned actor interface in the hosting project; test fakes and adapter shims can implement this interface without importing any DAPR package. The actor ID uses a three-tier model where the first segment is projectionType when supplied by the caller, otherwise queryType: {first}:{TenantId}:{EntityId} for entity-scoped queries, {first}:{TenantId}:{Checksum} for payload-scoped searches, and {first}:{TenantId} for tenant-wide lists.

member.summary: Internal-only diagnostic marker recorded when the opt-in safe-denial adapter unified a result into the shared not-found shape for a route that has opted into the safe-denial boundary. Never surfaced on the wire response — the caller-visible query router result for a safe-denied query carries the exact same shape as a genuine not-found result (no error message). This constant exists solely so server-side logs can still distinguish a policy-denied outcome from a genuinely nonexistent resource.

member.name: F:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Queries.QueryAdapterFailureReason.SafeDenialMissingProjectionState
member.summary: Internal-only diagnostic marker recorded when the opt-in safe-denial adapter unified the second existing not-found shape -- a projection actor's "no projection state available" failure message (see ) -- into the shared not-found shape for a route that has opted into the safe-denial boundary. Never surfaced on the wire response, for the same reason as .

member.name: F:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Queries.QueryAdapterFailureReason.MissingProjectionState
member.summary: The second existing not-found shape: a projection actor reports success=false with this exact error message (rather than the router result's hard not-found flag set to ) when no projection state has ever been built for the target aggregate. Recognized by the opt-in safe-denial adapter so both genuine not-found shapes are unified identically to a safe-denied Forbidden result.

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Rest.RestRouteAttribute
member.summary: Overrides the generated HTTP verb and route template for a command or query message. Applicable to both and types.
member.param: The HTTP verb for the generated endpoint.
The route template appended to the domain route prefix (e.g. "{tenantId}/users" or "~/api/users/{userId}/tenants"). May be empty to route at the prefix root.
member.remarks: When this attribute is absent the generator applies the convention fallback: commands map to POST {prefix}; queries map to GET {prefix} (or POST {prefix} when the query carries a body payload), where {prefix} is the assembly-level . The route template is structural; its shape is validated by the source generator, not here — only a null template is rejected. is optional for source contracts in the API host compilation. It is required for referenced contracts that should be emitted by a host with a non-empty so the generator can fail closed instead of publishing unrelated referenced contracts under the host route prefix. Example templates: "{tenantId}", "{tenantId}/users", "~/api/users/{userId}/tenants".

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Security.CryptoShreddingWorkflowIdentity
member.summary: Story 22.7c — stable idempotency key for a crypto-shredding workflow request. Two requests with identical identities are the same workflow; the second one returns the existing audit/status without creating a duplicate record. Equality is value-based across every required field. Raw key aliases NEVER appear: stores a SHA-256 hex prefix only when permits.
member.param: Caller-supplied stable ULID identifying the workflow request.
The scope of the workflow request.
Aggregate identifier (required when scope is Aggregate/Stream/Range).
Inclusive lower bound of the affected sequence range (required when scope is Range).
Inclusive upper bound of the affected sequence range. means open-ended.
The policy controlling whether a key reference is stored.
Optional SHA-256 hex prefix of the key alias (16 hex chars).

member.name: T:Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.Serialization.EventStorePayloadSerialization
member.summary: Single shared payload-binding serializer options for every EventStore reader path. The command, rehydrate, projection and pub/sub paths all bind persisted or wire payloads through so casing or converter drift cannot silently produce an empty, default-constructed payload on one path while the others bind correctly.

remarks.para: No persisted or wire payload writer uses these options: the two payload writers deliberately keep their current behaviour, so PascalCase payload bytes are already at rest and must stay readable. sets PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true, which accepts both the PascalCase bytes at rest and the camelCase bytes a normal API client submits. Widening a reader like this is always safe; narrowing it is not.

Besides payload binding, the same instance backs the serialization halves of in-process round trips that must agree with those readers — the rehydrator's arbitrary-snapshot SerializeToElement pass and the replay engine's StateJson rendering. Both are diagnostic or in-memory shapes, never persisted event bytes.
is made read-only during initialization so no consumer can mutate the shared instance and silently change binding behaviour for every other path.
